notes: Run of 2026-11-25. Two SF YIMBY stories queued, both published: preliminary permits for 307 homes replacing the former St. Anne's Home at 300 Lake Street, and the formal application for a 42-story tower at 329 Bryant Street (Hoodline's relay declined).

findings.description: Preliminary permits filed to redevelop the six-acre former St. Anne's Home site (care facility run by the Little Sisters of the Poor 1901–2025) into 307 units: a 262-unit eight-story apartment building and 45 townhomes, demolishing the three-story complex. A proposal: nothing goes in building.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Preliminary Permits Filed For 300 Lake Street, San Francisco,” 25 November 2026

raw.text: Preliminary permits have been filed for the six-acre redevelopment of a former residential care facility into housing at 300 Lake Street

findings.description: Formal permits filed for a 42-story, 448-ft, 270-unit tower at 329 Bryant under SB 423 and the state density bonus, up six floors from the late-2025 preliminary application; three structures to be demolished, the historic building at 329 Bryant kept. A proposal: nothing goes in building.
